## For Internal Use (Maintainers Only)

**Triage Information:**
- [ ] Bug confirmed
- [ ] Can reproduce
- [ ] Need more information
- [ ] Invalid/Not a bug

**Priority:**
- [ ] P0 - Critical (Fix immediately)
- [ ] P1 - High (Fix in current sprint)
- [ ] P2 - Medium (Fix in next sprint)
- [ ] P3 - Low (Fix when possible)

**Estimated Effort:**
- [ ] XS (< 1 day)
- [ ] S (1-2 days)
- [ ] M (3-5 days)
- [ ] L (1-2 weeks)
- [ ] XL (> 2 weeks)

**Root Cause Analysis:**
- [ ] Code defect
- [ ] Configuration issue
- [ ] External dependency
- [ ] User error
- [ ] Design flaw

**Labels to Add:**
- Platform: `android`, `ios`, `both`
- Component: `auth`, `scanning`, `ui`, `backend`
- Sprint: `sprint-X`
